run_export_scannet_scene: run the CLI to export a ScanNet scene with vertices, labels, and bounding boxes to numpy files
run_read_aggregation: run read_aggregation to parse a ScanNet aggregation JSON into object ID and label to segment mappings
run_read_segmentation: run read_segmentation to parse a ScanNet segmentation JSON into segment ID to vertex index mappings
run_export_function: run the export function to load mesh vertices, apply axis alignment, and compute semantic and instance labels
review_export_axis_alignment: review the export function axis alignment matrix loading and vertex transformation logic
